description: Fingerprint of the current working viewer, including local changes. This is not a Git release or a claim that all acceptance cases have passed.

courses.title: A small viewer you understand
courses.goal: Draw a mesh, move its camera and identify a selected object.

courses.title: Geometry that reads clearly
courses.goal: Add curves, points, CAD faces and text while retaining source identity.

courses.title: Documents that stay reliable
courses.goal: Load, stream, instance and release real scenes without losing their meaning.

courses.title: Editing that can be undone
courses.goal: Connect gestures, snapping, panels and document transactions.

courses.title: The modeling toolbox
courses.goal: Reach every existing command, shape, surface, annotation and split tool.

courses.title: The rendering quality we have now
courses.goal: Preserve finite visibility, section caps, outlines, ambient occlusion and transparency.

courses.title: Prove the complete viewer
courses.goal: Compare behavior, appearance, resource use and final source coverage against the reference.

features.title: 00 · Load Rust in the browser
features.purpose: Create the browser page and the Rust entry point.
features.acceptance: Why does a successful Rust build not yet give us a picture?

features.title: 01 · First WebGPU frame
features.purpose: Connect the GPU, allocate its shared resources and draw the first offscreen frame.
features.acceptance: Why should changing the background shader change lesson.ppm, while changing a camera target need not change a uniform background?

features.title: 02 · Camera
features.purpose: Implement orbit, pan and zoom, and turn a camera into a projection.
features.acceptance: Which data should change when you orbit, and which should remain unchanged?

features.title: 03 · Object rows and identity
features.purpose: Give displayed objects stable rows, placement and identity.
features.acceptance: Why is a triangle number insufficient to identify the object you selected?

features.title: 04a · Meshes on the GPU
features.purpose: Pack meshes into shared GPU storage and draw indexed triangles.
features.acceptance: What must agree when Rust writes a vertex and the shader reads it?

features.title: 04b · Strokes and arrows
features.purpose: Draw readable strokes and arrows with width and visibility rules.
features.acceptance: Why can a thick edge disappear when compared only with the depth at a neighbouring pixel?

features.title: 04c · Markers
features.purpose: Render points and control markers with identifiable owners.
features.acceptance: What is the difference between a marker’s display slot and its original control identity?

features.title: 04d · Point clouds
features.purpose: Organize point clouds and draw the detail needed for the current view.
features.acceptance: Why should selecting an original cloud point not depend only on the points currently drawn?

features.title: 05 · Depth and visible ink
features.purpose: Trace how surfaces decide whether nearby ink is visible.
features.acceptance: Why can two nearby pixels on one face have different valid depths?

features.title: 06 · CAD face rules
features.purpose: Translate editable CAD geometry into display records with source identity.
features.acceptance: Which representation would you edit to change a face, and which would you rebuild afterwards?

features.title: 07 · Shared boundaries
features.purpose: Follow the sampling and ordering of a shared CAD boundary.
features.acceptance: Why can independently sampling two mathematically identical edges leave a crack?

features.title: 08 · Trims, holes and periodic seams
features.purpose: Trace trims and holes from surface coordinates to displayed faces.
features.acceptance: Why do we need an edge’s use on a face as well as the three-dimensional edge itself?

features.title: 09 · Normals and shading
features.purpose: Check face winding and the normals used for shading.
features.acceptance: How can inconsistent face orientation become a visible shading problem?

features.title: 10 · Text shaping
features.purpose: Turn text into shaped glyph runs and measured positions.
features.acceptance: Why can character count not determine the width of a label?

features.title: 11 · Text rendering
features.purpose: Render shaped text, its coverage and its placement in the scene.
features.acceptance: Which part must run again when the text changes, and which work can a placement-only change reuse?

features.title: 12 · The viewer shell and picking
features.purpose: Connect browser events, redraw requests and asynchronous picking.
features.acceptance: Why must an old pick result be rejected after the camera or scene changes?

features.title: 13 · Source controls and cloud picks
features.purpose: Connect control selection and cloud picks to original source identities.
features.acceptance: Why should a control pick return an original identity instead of a marker-buffer index?

features.title: 14 · Loading scenes
features.purpose: Load a scene description and publish its geometry to the viewer.
features.acceptance: If a replacement scene is malformed, what should happen to the scene already on screen?

features.title: 15 · Publication and streamed reads
features.purpose: Read large published files through metadata and selected byte ranges.
features.acceptance: Why must metadata and later byte ranges refer to the same published file version?

features.title: 16 · Resource accounting and release
features.purpose: Track shared CPU/GPU allocations and release resources at the right time.
features.acceptance: Why can dropping a CPU reference fail to return the corresponding GPU allocation immediately?

features.title: 17 · Source faces, text objects and one silhouette
features.purpose: Present selected source faces, labels and a consistent silhouette.
features.acceptance: How can one source object drawn in many pieces still receive one meaningful nameplate?

features.title: 18 · Finite-triangle visibility
features.purpose: Build screen-tile lists for precise triangle visibility tests.
features.acceptance: What goes wrong if a triangle’s infinite plane is treated as the triangle itself?

features.title: 18a · Instancing
features.purpose: Prepare shared geometry for drawing at multiple placements.
features.acceptance: What can two identical chairs share, and what must remain separate?

features.title: 18b · Clipping planes and section caps
features.purpose: Apply clipping planes and draw the cut surfaces of eligible solids.
features.acceptance: Why does changing a clipping plane not mean that we have permanently split the source model?

features.title: 19 · Sheets: batched drawings with lazy metadata
features.purpose: Draw batched sheets while looking up detailed entity information on demand.
features.acceptance: How can one sheet object still let you identify a particular drawn entity?

features.title: 20 · The document and its rows
features.purpose: Connect document transactions, undo/redo and display synchronization.
features.acceptance: When undo restores a removed object, why must more than the visible pixels be restored?

features.title: 21 · Direct editing
features.purpose: Implement direct editing, previews, cancellation and final commits.
features.acceptance: What should differ between cancelling a drag and releasing it to accept the edit?

features.title: 22 · The egui layer
features.purpose: Draw the egui interface above the scene and manage its resources.
features.acceptance: Why must the interface pass preserve the scene colour already in the target?

features.title: 23 · The command line: one verb per file
features.purpose: Connect command words and options to application actions.
features.acceptance: Where should a command such as a display toggle hand off its work?

features.title: 23a · Tools that ask for points
features.purpose: Build interactive tools that ask for a sequence of points or choices.
features.acceptance: Why should the first and second points of Move be different tool states?

features.title: 23b · Shapes
features.purpose: Construct shapes from the dimensions and frame collected by a tool.
features.acceptance: What would you inspect if the accepted box differs from its preview?

features.title: 23c · Surfacing
features.purpose: Turn selected curves and surfacing choices into new surface geometry.
features.acceptance: Why can reordering the same loft sections change the result?

features.title: 23d · Annotate and measure
features.purpose: Measure geometry and display the resulting annotations.
features.acceptance: Why do distance and displacement answer different questions?

features.title: 24 · Snapping
features.purpose: Connect the Snap command to the snapping system introduced during direct editing.
features.acceptance: Why should the snap aperture be measured in pixels rather than fixed world units?

features.title: 25 · Draw a solid, readable gumball
features.purpose: Render identifiable gumball handles with a clear on-screen shape.
features.acceptance: Why do the gumball and a scene mesh need separate depth behavior?

features.title: 26 · The nested session panel
features.purpose: Represent a nested scene as expandable panel rows.
features.acceptance: What does collapsing a group change, and what should it leave untouched?

features.title: 30 · The layers panel and the layer tree
features.purpose: Apply layer visibility and selection through shared source identities.
features.acceptance: Why should hiding a group use the same identity mapping as selection?

features.title: 31 · Split curves and faces
features.purpose: Connect splitting tools, cutters and the resulting geometry edits.
features.acceptance: How would you distinguish a wrong split from a correct split that is displayed incorrectly?

features.title: 32 · Ambient occlusion
features.purpose: Estimate ambient occlusion using depth data and a depth pyramid.
features.acceptance: Why can a camera change require new occlusion work even if no geometry was edited?

features.title: 33 · GTAO, Arctic and Outline
features.purpose: Connect Arctic, outline and contact-shading controls to render state.
features.acceptance: Which data should remain unchanged when you switch a lighting style?

features.title: 35 · Element features
features.purpose: Show or hide element features through the shared display state.
features.acceptance: Why can rebuilding feature rows require clearing selection or controls?

features.title: 36 · Translucent faces and Opacity
features.purpose: Expose face opacity through the command and state layers.
features.acceptance: Why is parsing a valid opacity number not enough to make transparency correct?

features.title: 37 · Self-test: the finished viewer
features.purpose: Exercise the finished viewer from a scene file through GPU output.
features.acceptance: If a selected object moves on screen, how would you establish that the edit really changed the document?

quality.name: Camera and browser
quality.required: Orbit, pan, zoom, resize and high-DPI rendering; keyboard focus, mouse and touch; device errors are visible.

quality.name: Identity and selection
quality.required: Objects, source faces, edges, points and controls map back to the correct original; stale asynchronous picks are rejected.

quality.name: CAD ink
quality.required: Shared boundaries, trims, holes, periodic seams, normals and finite-triangle occlusion preserve the crafted edge appearance.

quality.name: Text
quality.required: Shaping, symbols, label placement, source text and outlines remain readable at the reference views.

quality.name: Large scenes
quality.required: Point clouds, streamed reads, sheets, instancing and released documents preserve IDs and bounded resource use.

quality.name: Transactions
quality.required: Preview, accept, cancel, undo and redo agree with the document and displayed geometry.

quality.name: Tools
quality.required: Every command implementation in the source inventory has a demonstrated invocation, result and cancellation/error case where applicable.

quality.name: Panels and input
quality.required: Layer trees, nested panels, command input, snapping and gumball agree on selection and respect pointer/keyboard ownership.

quality.name: Presentation
quality.required: Opaque and translucent faces, section caps, silhouettes, Arctic, ambient occlusion and feature controls match representative reference scenes.

quality.name: Persistence
quality.required: Save and open preserve supported geometry, placement, identity, layers and document data.

quality.name: Performance
quality.required: Compare frame time, peak GPU allocations and release-after-replacement on the same hardware, viewport and scene; record agreed tolerances before accepting differences.

quality.name: Release
quality.required: Browser gestures and visual comparisons pass, every feature is mapped, and any intentional source difference has a reviewed explanation.
